traces.data:
r : ℕ
inst✝⁹ : NeZero r
L : Type
inst✝⁸ : Field L
inst✝⁷ : Fintype L
inst✝⁶ : DecidableEq L
𝔽q : Type
inst✝⁵ : Field 𝔽q
inst✝⁴ : Fintype 𝔽q
inst✝³ : DecidableEq 𝔽q
h_Fq_char_prime : Fact (Nat.Prime (ringChar 𝔽q))
hF₂ : Fact (Fintype.card 𝔽q = 2)
inst✝² : Algebra 𝔽q L
β : Fin r → L
hβ_lin_indep : Fact (LinearIndependent 𝔽q β)
h_β₀_eq_1 : Fact (β 0 = 1)
ℓ 𝓡 : ℕ
inst✝¹ : NeZero 𝓡
h_ℓ_add_R_rate : ℓ + 𝓡 < r
i : Fin ℓ
steps : ℕ
inst✝ : NeZero steps
h_i_add_steps : ↑i + steps ≤ ℓ
f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩
h_fw_dist_lt :
  2 * ↑(fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f) <
    ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, fiberwiseClose._proof_3 i steps h_i_add_steps⟩)
d_fw : ℕ := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f
C_i : Submodule L
  (↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate
        ⟨↑⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩,
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
            (Fin.is_le ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩)
            (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩) →
    L) :=
  BBF_Code 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩
d_H : ℕ∞ := Δ₀(f, ↑C_i)
d_i : ℕ :=
  BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩
d_i_plus_steps : ℕ :=
  BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i + steps, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ fiberwiseClose._proof_1 i steps h_i_add_steps a⟩
h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0
h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty ↥C_i
g' :
  ↥(sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate
        ⟨↑⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩,
          Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt
            (Fin.is_le ⟨↑i, Decidable.byContradiction fun a ↦ is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point._proof_1 i steps a⟩)
            (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩) →
    L
h_g'_mem : g' ∈ C_i
h_g'_min_card : d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard
h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : ↑Δ₀(f, g') ≤ ↑d_fw * 2 ^ steps
h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ ↑d_fw * 2 ^ steps
h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1
⊢ ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i
